data.name: Lalman
data.gender_notes: Lalman is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Lalman is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Lal' meaning 'God' and 'Man' meaning 'of the universe'. In Hindu mythology, Lalman is a manifestation of Lord Vishnu and is worshipped for his cosmic powers. He is believed to be the protector of the universe and the sustainer of life. The name Lalman carries the meaning “God of the universe” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Lalman usually hope their child will grow to embody god of the universe and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of cosmic power and divine protection.
data.etymology: Lalman belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of the universe.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Lalman total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

data.cultural_impact: The name Lalman holds deep cultural roots in Hinduism. It is a reminder of the belief in the divine powers that govern the universe and sustain life. In Hindu cultures, naming a child after a deity is believed to bestow blessing and divine protection upon the child. The name Lalman is an invitation to the child to embody the divine qualities of the deity and to live a virtuous life.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Lalman is centered around the worship of Lord Vishnu. Lord Vishnu is considered the preserver of the universe, and Lalman is his manifestation. By bearing this name, an individual is believed to be close to Lord Vishnu and is granted his blessings and protection. The name Lalman serves as a constant reminder of the divine presence and inspires one to live a life in alignment with the divine principles.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Lalita Manavata, meaning 'the embodiment of grace and human manifestation', is the symbolic and spiritual meaning behind the Hindu name 'Lalman'. It signifies the divine grace and human potential to transcend the mundane and achieve the extraordinary.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Lalman is a name mentioned in the Mahabharata, an ancient Indian epic. The name Lalman carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Lalman is a character name in the Mahabharata.

modern_usage.modern_context: In today's interconnected world, the name Lalman continues to be cherished by Hindu families globally. It is frequently featured on social media platforms where parents share their naming journeys, and Hindu name websites where expectant parents research meaningful names. The name bridges traditional Hindu values with modern Indian identity, making it relevant for contemporary families seeking names with deep spiritual and cultural significance.
